activity.notes: Miyamoto Musashi's famous duel against Sasaki Kojiro at Funashima (Ganryujima) is traditionally dated to Keicho 17 (1612). Official Shimonoseki City/Kitakyushu City tourism interpretive records commemorate the duel, while the 1654 Kokura memorial and later narratives differ on particulars. The year-only interval avoids converting the Japanese traditional fourth-month date into an unverified Gregorian day, or asserting disputed duel details and the legend of 60 undefeated bouts as verifiable statistics. The relation active_in Tokugawa-period Japan implies neither service to the central shogunate nor sovereign authority; existing 1640–1645 late-life Activity is unchanged.
